description.value: Jimy Mac's is a neighbourhood pub and liquor store in Langley, BC, serving a full menu of pub classics from weekend brunch through late-night burgers and share plates. The pub pours a broad selection of local and imported draught beers, house cocktails, and wine, and offers a delivery service. Cyclists on the Fraser Valley road network will find it a convenient full-service stop for a substantial meal in a casual community setting.
